headline: Uzbekistan and Afghanistan to Negotiate Water Sharing Upon Canal Completion
summary: Uzbekistan's Water Resources Minister stated that Afghanistan's Qosh Tepa Canal will not draw water from the Amu Darya River before 2030, with formal water-sharing negotiations expected once construction is completed.
why: Transboundary river management along the Amu Darya is crucial for agricultural irrigation and economic stability in Central Asia.
